issues.current_content:
# Performance

This chapter will be populated with content from the codebase analysis.

*This content will be populated by the documentation drift detection workflow.*
issues.should_add: Comprehensive documentation of all performance-related features, benchmarks, optimization techniques, and tuning options
issues.fix_suggestion: Create complete chapter covering: parallelism, threading, memory mapping, SIMD optimizations, buffer tuning, sorting performance, statistics, and benchmarking guidance

issues.description: No documentation of ripgrep's parallel search capabilities and threading model
issues.should_add: Explain default multi-threaded behavior, thread count control (-j/--threads), single-threaded mode, work stealing, lock-free parallel iteration
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Parallel Search' explaining how ripgrep uses multiple threads by default, how to control thread count, when to use single-threaded mode, and the work-stealing architecture

issues.description: No documentation of memory mapping feature and when it's used
issues.should_add: Explain --mmap flag, automatic memory mapping selection based on file size, performance tradeoffs, --no-mmap option
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Memory Mapping' explaining how ripgrep uses memory-mapped I/O for large files, when it's beneficial, and how to control it with --mmap/--no-mmap flags

issues.description: No documentation of SIMD optimizations and literal extraction performance features
issues.should_add: Explain how ripgrep uses SIMD for fast literal matching, literal extraction from regex patterns, automatic optimization selection
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Low-Level Optimizations' covering SIMD-accelerated searching, literal extraction optimization, and how ripgrep automatically chooses the fastest strategy

issues.description: No documentation of sorting options and their performance impact
issues.should_add: Explain --sort and --sortr flags, available sort keys (path, modified, accessed, created), impact on parallelism
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Sorting Results' explaining how --sort disables parallel search for deterministic ordering, available sort keys, and performance tradeoffs

issues.description: No documentation of buffer size control and heap limits
issues.should_add: Explain buffer size optimization, heap limit configuration, line buffer optimization, --line-buffered and --block-buffered flags
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Buffer and Memory Tuning' covering buffer size control, heap limits, and buffering modes for different use cases

issues.description: No documentation of DFA size limits and regex size limits for controlling regex engine memory
issues.should_add: Explain --dfa-size-limit and --regex-size-limit flags, when to adjust them, impact on performance and memory usage
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Regex Engine Tuning' explaining DFA size limits, regex size limits, and when to adjust these for very large patterns or memory-constrained environments

issues.description: No documentation of --stats flag for performance analysis
issues.should_add: Explain --stats flag, what statistics are reported, how to interpret them for performance tuning
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Performance Statistics' showing how to use --stats to see search timing, bytes searched, matches found, and other metrics for performance analysis

issues.description: No guidance on benchmarking ripgrep or comparing performance
issues.should_add: Provide best practices for benchmarking, common performance comparisons, factors affecting speed
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: 'Benchmarking' with guidance on fair performance testing, warm vs cold cache, file system effects, and how to measure ripgrep's actual performance in different scenarios

issues.description: No documentation of binary detection strategies and their performance impact
issues.should_add: Explain binary detection using NUL byte heuristics, performance impact, --binary flag
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection in relevant section explaining how binary detection works, its performance characteristics, and when to use --binary flag

issues.description: No documentation of performance differences between default and PCRE2 engines
issues.should_add: Explain performance characteristics of default Rust regex vs PCRE2, when to use each
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section or note about regex engine performance tradeoffs: finite automata (default) vs backtracking (PCRE2), and --engine auto selection

issues.description: No mention of performance characteristics on different platforms
issues.should_add: Note any significant performance differences between Windows, macOS, and Linux
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about cross-platform performance if there are significant differences worth mentioning
